parties.respondent: The State of West Bengal & Ors.

summary: Abetment of suicide under IPC s.306; instigation requires close proximity, clear mens rea, active role; mere disapproval of relationship insufficient; statement of deceased about appellant's remark considered; High Court correctly found prima facie case; reliance on Rohini Sudarshan Gangurde, Prakash, Ramesh Kumar, Pawan Kumar; no wilful instigation established; appeal dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; impugned order upholding charge against appellant upheld.
